AboutPage.title: About Global IT
AboutPage.subtitle: We help career switchers become hired engineers, with real mentorship and real outcomes.
AboutPage.missionText: We believe a career in tech shouldn't require a four-year degree or years of self-teaching. Global IT was founded to give motivated people a structured, mentor-led path into real engineering jobs — with the same rigor as a top-tier bootcamp, delivered by people who still build software for a living.
AboutPage.teamSubtitle: The people who'll actually be teaching you.
